## Highlights

- Dictation now clearly reports when a recording ends without recognized text, including a dedicated message for Gemini early finalization.
- Very short accidental dictation taps remain quiet, with an adjustable short-press threshold in Debug settings.
- The history limit field now waits until editing is finished before applying the new value.

---

**Notice:**
If the application crashes on an older CPU during transcription, use the [Microsoft Store Edition](https://github.com/MaxITService/AIVORelay/releases/tag/v1.0.38-store) for this version.

Optional: Windows users can install AivoRelay's self-signed root certificate to trust GitHub builds from Max IT Service. AivoRelay also works without it, but Windows may show publisher or SmartScreen warnings. See the [certificate installation guide](https://github.com/MaxITService/AIVORelay/blob/main/docs/WINDOWS-CERTIFICATE-INSTALLATION.md).
